result.summary: Sub-step B4 of section 12 is built by section 4.7 (and the Docker line of 4.12) of the design: the two demo routes of the public landing over the byte copy of the picker engine and Sai's own intake, which store nothing and log no answer. First an inventory: no earlier launch of B4 had left anything (app/server/routes/demo.js did not exist, the five other files of the row were byte-equal to the build tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build, and there was no B4 handoff), so all six files are this launch's. app/server/routes/demo.js (new) holds INTAKE_FILE in the literal form of 4.7, loadIntake (the shape rule of 4.7, never throws), inLanguage (the rule of tenantInLanguage of the picker's view module written again, an own key __proto__ kept an own key, a language outside ru, kk, en giving ru as the original does) and demoRoutes with the two handlers: 503 demo_unavailable for a missing or broken intake, the language by pickLang from ?lang= alone, the questionnaire and the result built field by field, the refusals bad_json, bad_body, bad_answers, unknown_question, unknown_option and wrong_kind, an engine exception as demo_unavailable; it is the only importer of the copy. routes/index.js puts the demo rows first when the app is given the demo, then health; http/errors.js has the seven new codes; app.js passes { query, body } to a handler and answers a thrown HttpError with its status, body and log code (anything else goes to onError), and createFunctionApp gives the demo the public languages (PUBLIC_LANGS, ru and en); node-main.js gives it SOURCE_LANGS and prints one stderr line when the intake is missing or broken; the Dockerfile copies content after db. The row's own check, measured on a fresh clone of the build tag with the run's 26 finished files (state A) and then this row's six (state B), and again on the project after the save: PORT=0 node server/node-main.js with 64 curl rows of F13 on the app host — 164 checks of my own oracle, 0 failures (27 results equal to the original engine on tenantInLanguage, the refusal codes, the uniform 404 of the other methods, no-store, no Set-Cookie, one log line per request with the keys of REQ-108 criterion 10 and every value of its closed form, no answer value); the missing-intake run (clone only) answers 503 demo_unavailable on both routes with health and the page as before and the one stderr line; the gate answers first; an in-process driver of the function entry with PUBLIC_LANGS and of createApp — 108 checks, 0 failures (35 entry results and 21 local results equal to the original engine, kk and every other value in Russian through the function, none of the 103 Kazakh-only texts of the intake leaves it, the database adapter called 0 times by 100 demo requests with a positive control, planted fields reach no answer, an engine that throws gives 503 and the next request is answered, 17 hostile intake files give { ok: false } without an exception). 13 mutants of the demo (the design's M09, M11–M14, M16, M17 and M19, a variant of M15, and four of my own) are each red in the driver or the rows check; the files were restored and compared. The static part is clean (prettier, eslint, tsc 0 with no error, check-public, vendored, the content step); test:unit is 46 with 43 passing and red exactly IB-1 (B1), CP-2's js/ line (B2) and NPM-3 (B3), byte-identical to state A without this row, and IB-1 still names only the one .d.ts line, so the row adds no import finding; test:int is 36 of 36 in the clone and in the project. No red test of this row. cd tools && npm run traces: 2765 files, 0 traces. No secret, hidden character or bypass form in the six files. Found on the way, named for ORCH and the reviewers: the measured design-literal answer for an intake that passes the shape check but holds an option that is not an object (I6), the tracer form of F14 not re-measured without the network (I7), HEAD answered by the GET route as for /api/health (I5), a leading byte-order mark consumed by the strict decoder (I8), and the task's done list that omits B3 (I4).
